components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The principal safe action in the current operating context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--oum-action, #2868d7); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); color: #fff; font: 620 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--oum-action-dark, #174b9f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or lower-priority action on a work surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--oum-line-strong, #aeb9b0); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); font: 620 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); background: var(--oum-action-soft, #e8effd); color: var(--oum-action-dark, #174b9f); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A full-width router setting with a persistent human label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); font: 650 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--oum-line-strong, #aeb9b0); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--oum-paper-strong, #fff); color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); font: 400 15px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Console
components.description: The single four-channel instrument that answers the first network-health questions.
components.css: .ds-console { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--oum-console, #172c28); color: #f4f8f5; box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(31,49,42,.08); font-family: system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-console > i { position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 20px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--oum-signal, #d7f06b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(215,240,107,.1); } .ds-console > div { min-height: 112px; padding: 24px 22px 20px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(234,244,238,.14); } .ds-console > div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-console small { display: block; margin-bottom: 20px; color: #aebfb7; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-console strong { color: #fff; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-console:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; } @media(max-width:700px){.ds-console{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-console>div{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(234,244,238,.14)}.ds-console>div:last-child{border-bottom:0}}

components.name: Work Surface
components.description: A large paper section containing one coherent operating circuit.
components.html:
Подключённые устройства

Устройства и их текущая маршрутизация.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--oum-line, #cfd6ce); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--oum-paper, #fbfcf8); color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(31,49,42,.045); font: 400 15px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.22rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--oum-subtle, #627068); } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--oum-line-strong, #aeb9b0); } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Choice
components.description: An accessible setting choice shown as selected without introducing another card.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--oum-action, #2868d7); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--oum-action-soft, #e8effd); color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--oum-action, #2868d7); font: 400 15px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice input { accent-color: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); } .ds-choice span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; } .ds-choice small { color: var(--oum-subtle, #627068); } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--oum-action-dark, #174b9f); } .ds-choice:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Route Switch
components.description: A binary device-routing control with one shared outline.
components.css: .ds-route { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--oum-line-strong, #aeb9b0); border-radius: 8px; font: 620 15px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-route label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-route input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-route span { display: block; min-width: 108px; padding: 8px 11px; text-align: center; color: var(--oum-ink, #17231f); } .ds-route label:has(input:checked) span { background: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); color: #fff; } .ds-route label:hover span { color: var(--oum-action-dark, #174b9f); } .ds-route label:has(input:checked):hover span { color: #fff; background: var(--oum-action-dark, #174b9f); } .ds-route:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Setup Progress
components.description: A thin circuit-like track for the focused first-run flow.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); margin: 24px 0; background: #dde3dc; } .ds-progress span { position: relative; height: 5px; } .ds-progress .is-active { background: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); } .ds-progress .is-current::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -5px; top: -3px; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--oum-action, #2868d7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--oum-action-soft, #e8effd); } .ds-progress:hover .is-current::after { transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-progress:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(40,104,215,.32); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
OUM is a calm, precise control surface for domestic infrastructure. It makes the network read as one labeled engineering circuit rather than a collection of unrelated admin cards: a deep green instrument summarizes health, while paper-light work surfaces hold safe controls and progressively disclosed expert detail.

The mode is Operate. Normal operation stays quiet; action blue and state colors appear only where they carry meaning. The interface remains recognizably OUM across the dashboard, settings, and first-run recovery route without imitating LuCI's default administrative table language.
keyCharacteristics: One dark, unified status instrument above large light work surfaces.
Warm green-gray neutrals, ruled channels, and sparse signal-lamp accents.
Human Russian copy first; technical values remain precise and scannable.
Expert controls are present but visually secondary and progressively disclosed.
Responsive order, keyboard focus, text-backed states, and reduced motion are system invariants.

rules.name: The Signal Is Sparse Rule
rules.body: Signal lime is a lamp, cursor, or selection highlight—not a panel background.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red may reinforce a state but never carry its meaning alone.

rules.name: The Appliance Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the local sans stack for the interface; reserve monospace for content that is genuinely code-like or machine-shaped.

rules.name: The Circuit Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive reflow may change columns, but it never changes the operational story: health, devices, protected connection, then advanced control.

rules.name: The One Instrument Rule
rules.body: The status console may lift as a whole; its channels never become independently shadowed cards.

rules.name: The Outer Curves, Inner Lines Rule
rules.body: Round the containing instrument; structure its contents with straight rules and tonal fields.

dos: Do lead with network health and place the next safe action beside the relevant state.
Do preserve one source of truth for each setting and keep dangerous or expert operations visually secondary.
Do accompany every operational color with explicit Russian state text.
Do preserve keyboard focus, 42px touch targets where interaction demands them, reduced-motion behavior, and mobile wrapping.
Do use local system assets only; the router interface must remain light and independent of remote fonts, images, or libraries.
donts: Don't turn the dashboard into a grid of unrelated floating metric cards.
Don't nest cards inside work surfaces when a rule, rhythm, or tonal field can express the hierarchy.
Don't use Signal Lime as decoration or a large fill.
Don't require hover, color vision, LuCI knowledge, or technical jargon to understand a primary task.
Don't visually imply changes to RPC, UCI, routing, rollback, permissions, or any other networking behavior.
